consumer: The dialogue/condition u_has_items check the border guard's search consumes (set_has_items lambda) asking the yes/no 'does the avatar possess the contraband item?'
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person possession via has_charges/has_amount), not nearby/reachable inventory
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::set_has_items — its lambda returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over the character actor, i.e. an engine-COMPUTED possession predicate
divergence: Contraband nested inside a worn container/pocket: has_amount counts it as possessed (guard check = yes), but a re-derivation from avatar.carried_items[] flat enumeration could miss or mis-locate it, yielding the wrong yes/no
